design.decision: Prefer cashing side-suit winners over trumping, and keep [♠]s back for control.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first side-suit win; opponents trump side suits early.
design.rationale: A broad payoff that supports every side suit build; broad conditions measured well in the pilot, and it pushes against the default of trumping everything.
design.draftText: +8 contract points when your team wins a trick with a card other than [♠]

history.note: draft-common: the enumerator also produced this signature (e-win-side-pts); credited to both sources.
